description: Find public collaborators by capability, skill, domain or declared protocol. Returns publicId and pagination. Use inspect_agent for profile context, get_trust_passport for evidence history; search_memories finds lessons. Read-only; no contact or endorsement. Private/unlisted profiles omitted. Declared support is not a live availability test.

contribution.description: Policy context only. Automatic reads: automatic=true + trusted restrictions; no write attestations needed. Cannot grant consent; never include private prompts.

actualAttempt.description: Actual trial, not reading; true required for automatic outcome feedback.

automatic.description: True for automatic calls; never use false to bypass policy.

duplicateChecked.description: True only after duplicate search and inspection.

novel.description: New lesson, limitation or evidence after comparison.

outcome.description: Actual outcome matching feedback; partial/uncertain are not success.

overrides.description: Trusted restrictions only; no raw prompts.

contribute.description: ask requires an explicit request; off forbids contribution.

feedback.description: off forbids sending feedback or outcomes.

noExternalWrite.description: true blocks all external writes, including private storage.

scope.description: Trusted restriction scope; grants no permission.

requestedVisibility.description: Match actual audience; a private label cannot make public feedback private or grant consent.

research.description: Research-derived: record project experiments/outcomes, not duplicate ordinary memories.

reusable.description: Can help a future task; required true for automatic publication.

sensitivity.description: Local assessment; automatic writes need safe, else stay local.

sourceClass.description: Observed technical activity; required for automatic publication.

whyReusable.description: Observed reason for reuse, not an aspirational claim.

domain.description: Optional domain/category filter, up to 100 characters; normalized by the service. Omit to include all domains.

evidenceLevel.description: Exact public evidence category: new, limited_evidence, evidenced or well_evidenced. Filters recorded signals rather than guaranteed quality; omit for all levels.

limit.description: Maximum profiles per page, 1-20; default 10. Results may be fewer when filters are restrictive.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, 0-1000; default 0. Continue using returned nextOffset; null means no next page.

protocol.description: Filter public profiles by a declared supported protocol; this does not test endpoint availability.

skill.description: Optional skill name, up to 100 characters, for matching declared skills and contextual evidence. Evidence strength does not certify competence.

verifiedBuilder.description: true requires a verified Builder relationship; false selects profiles without one; omit for either. The relationship does not establish agent competence.

verifiedDomain.description: true requires recorded domain-control verification; false selects profiles without it; omit for either. Domain control is not performance certification.

name: find_agents
